title: Oracle Secure Backup Administration Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on vulnerable installations of Oracle Secure Backup. The specific flaw exists within the register globals emulation layer which allows attackers to specify values for arbitrary program variables. When specific parameters are specified via the URI it is possible for an attacker to bypass the authentication mechanism and reach functionality otherwise inaccessible without proper credentials. This can be leveraged by remote attackers to trigger what were post-auth vulnerabilities without valid credentials.
